request.deadline: 9-month delivery period from July 2026 to March 2027
deliverables: Audited Bitcoin-Cardano bridge running on Cardano mainnet in federated and SPO-threshold custody modes under controlled access
Independent stewardship structure or equivalent form determined in Phase 1
SPO and dApp partner pipeline required for public launch
Public reporting of operations, milestone progress, treasury disbursements, and on-chain activity
request.what: Fund Phase 1 of 2 to take Bifrost from working testnet to launch readiness, including hardening, security audits, formal verification, ecosystem and partner readiness, stewardship, and economic foundations for launch.

claims.claim: Bifrost is designed as a permissionless Bitcoin-Cardano bridge secured by Cardano's existing SPO ecosystem that brings BTC onto Cardano as native fBTC for DeFi use cases.
The requested treasury withdrawal is ₳12,332,031, approximately $1,973,125 at 0.16 USD/ADA, including a 10% refundable contingency.
Bifrost is currently funded through Catalyst Fund 14 for ₳739,000 and is intended to prove the architecture end-to-end on testnet by August 2026.
The proposal states that by the end of Phase 1 Bifrost will be audited and running on Cardano mainnet in both federated and SPO-threshold custody modes under controlled access.

Bifrost custody of locked BTC is described as distributed across 400+ Cardano SPOs, weighted by delegation, with fund movements requiring a cryptographic threshold representing the majority of delegated stake.
The proposal states that fBTC will be issued and burned 1:1 with BTC locked in the Bifrost custody script on Bitcoin.
The proposer claims Bifrost will be public infrastructure with no bridge token, no founder allocation, Apache 2.0 open source code, public accountability, and independent stewardship.
The proposal targets 1,200 BTC, about 600,000 annual transactions, and 3,000 fBTC-holding wallets by Q2 2029 as its base contribution to Cardano 2030 KPIs.
The proposal claims bridge fees in fBTC will fund operations and that surplus will be split to SPOs and the Cardano Treasury.
The proposal separates public rollout and 24 months of operations into a planned Phase 2 proposal in Q1 2027 after the bridge has been proven on-chain.

summary: The document requests ₳12,332,031 for Bifrost Phase 1, a July 2026 to March 2027 effort by FluidTokens and Lantr Engineering to harden, audit, verify, steward, and prepare a Bitcoin-Cardano bridge for controlled mainnet launch before a later Phase 2 public rollout and operations proposal.
